mapper.sql: CASE WHEN replace(trim(${col}::text), ',', '') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN replace(trim(${col}::text), ',', '')::numeric END
CASE WHEN lower(trim(${col}::text)) IN ('1', 'y', 'yes', 'true', 't') THEN true WHEN lower(trim(${col}::text)) IN ('0', 'n', 'no', 'false', 'f') THEN false END

CASE WHEN ${col} ILIKE '%ain%' THEN 'AAM' WHEN ${col} ILIKE '%dhafra%' OR ${col} ILIKE '%western%' OR ${col} ILIKE '%gharbia%' THEN 'WRM' WHEN ${col} ILIKE '%abu%dhabi%' OR ${col} ILIKE '%capital%' THEN 'ADM' END
